builds.title: AmberX: hands-free listening on screen + in background, ActiveX-style detection overlay (level graph, dB, quick settings)
builds.detail: Brett, Oct 27 2026 (claude.ai): 'It only detects words when I press speak' in AmberX (apps/amberx-droid). Cause: the native wake listener runs only while 'Watch axHub in the background' is on (default off) and pauses while the app is on screen. builds.title: Share Search: programmable grid toolbar plugin (search/filter bar + 5 buttons + advanced search), attach to grids
builds.detail:
Brett Oct 28 2026 (claude.ai): make a plugin with a toolbar of programmable actions for filtering, sorting and searching grids. Toolbar name: Share Search. HELD: Brett said 'send to orchestrator and hold off on build' — don't start until he says.

Asked, in full:
- Toolbar config lives in one of several settings groups inside the plugin's settings interface (Settings → Plugins → Share Search). Set what each toolbar item looks like, how it behaves and what it does.
- At app launch, if the plugin isn't attached to any data (grid), prompt with a dialog to attach it: lists every grid in a grid with expanding rows. Can attach to several; each attachment has its own saved settings, look, style and actions.
- Search bar can be a Filter or a Search (switch in its settings); updates the list in real time on every keystroke.
- Toolbar settings are in a tab list inside the plugin settings: one tab per attachment.
- Quick access: right-click on the toolbar → context menu item opens that toolbar's settings in a dialog.
- The search bar's settings sit in the toolbar settings' Appearance section: a collapsible container with an 'Inherit from shell' switch above it, collapsed by default. When inherit is off the container becomes expandable and shows every individual style token and setting as in the main app's settings.
- Along with the search bar: 5 toolbar buttons configured to manage the grid's view and actions, plus a button that opens an Advanced search & filter dialog.
- Install the plugin on the Console NOT attached to anything, to test the attach prompt dialog.

Design notes (proposed, Brett to confirm at build start): default 5 buttons = Sort (column + direction menu), Quick filter (per-column), Columns (show/hide), Expand/collapse all, Density (compact toggle) + Advanced search button. Toolbar config stored as a toolbar asset per attachment so it's hot-swappable. Plugin rules apply: framework controls only (inherits app style), plugin-lifecycle@1 install/uninstall, builtWith, settings sub-tab of Plugins, snaps never overlaps (Oct 28 rule), context-menu link via rt.addContextItems. Clash check: pending-grid-view (Pending builds grid toolbar) and opus/orchestrator-grid use the same lib-datagrid — build after/with them; Share Search can later attach to those grids. Android twin of the grid-attach seam is a deferred gap (Android hold).

builds.title: Approval costs + history: cost on every approval, history browser (console + axHub), one-call wait with AmberX alert
builds.detail:
Brett Oct 28 2026 (claude.ai): 'Add cost of approval every time something is approved and display costs, as well as all details and history of past approvals browsing. Can you alert when needing approval without stopping and restarting.' Context: he asked whether sending an approval and waiting costs tokens. Answer given: waiting is free, but each retry check re-reads the conversation (mostly cached). The 15 s x10 then 1 min rule costs about 10-15 checks per 5 minutes. HELD: queued, not started. Picks (cards): profile Refactor, held; history in the Console AND on axHub's approvals page.

Scope:
1) Cost per approval: every approval records the session's token/cost spent while it waited (number of checks, tokens in/out, cached vs not, USD from framework/schemas/model-pricing.json), plus the time it waited and who/what asked (session, surface, machine, build ref, reason title/description, exact call, result).
2) History browser: every past approval with all details and its cost; filter/sort/search, totals per day/build/session. Console = History view in the approvals-banner plugin (framework DataGrid, expanding rows). axHub = same list on its approvals page. Approve stays on the first screen.
3) Alert without stopping/restarting: a hub-side wait (axhub tool, e.g. approvals.wait / long-poll on the confirmation id, up to ~10 min per call) so a session makes ONE call that returns the moment Brett approves. No retry loop and no session restart. The AmberX app push (already shipped, amberx-push) fires when the approval is created. Then update the shared retry rule (15 s x10, then 1 min) to 'one wait call, re-issued only if it times out' — Brett to confirm that rule change at build time.
Work spans MossesX/axHub (wait tool, cost fields, approvals page history) and AXF (approvals-banner History view, cost capture via codebase-changes hooks / session transcript).

steps.text: axHub: approval record gains cost + wait fields (checks, tokens, USD, waited seconds, session/surface/machine, buildRef, result); API to list/filter history; migration for old records (cost unknown)
axHub: wait tool (long-poll on a confirmation id, returns on approve/reject/expire, ~10 min max per call); AmberX push fires on create; docs
Session cost capture: hooks/claude.ai path report tokens + checks spent per approval (from transcript, model-pricing.json) to the hub record
History browsers: console approvals-banner History view (DataGrid, expanding rows, filters, totals) + axHub approvals page history tab with costs; Approve stays on first screen
Update shared retry rule to one wait call (after Brett confirms); tests, lifecycle check, theme-swap, screenshots; THREADS; PRs (AXF + axHub) + merge approvals
